mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for interior demolition work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a licensed, bonded, and insured general contractor or demolition specialist who carries active worker compensation coverage and liability insurance. Ask about their dust containment protocols, disposal procedures, and utility isolation steps. A dependable contractor will provide a clear scope of work detailing what will be removed, what will be protected, where dumpsters will be staged, and how debris will be hauled away. Choosing a contractor who understands building structure prevents costly accidents, such as punctured plumbing lines, severed live wires, or damage to critical load-bearing framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select a licensed, insured contractor experienced in structural framing and utility systems who uses formal dust containment and provides transparent disposal plans.
